description: Canterbury Earthquake Precise-Levelling Heights (2010, 2011) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Geodetic Office. The Canterbury region of New Zealand experienced a sequence of significant earthquakes during 2010 and 2011. These earthquakes occurred on 2010-09-04, 2011-02-22, 2011-06-13 and 2011-12-23. Precise-levelling surveys have been carried out throughout Canterbury and Christchurch to re-establish heights after these earthquakes. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher National Geodetic Office. Its tags are HAZARDS-Earthquake, New Zealand, LAND-Cadastre, LAND-Geodesy. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2022-06-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
